paper_title: Search for oscillations of fundamental constants using molecular spectroscopy
suggested_experiment_name: Molecular iodine spectroscopy (d_me); EP tests envelope
notes: Paper constrains coupling of oscillating UDM field to quarks/gluons (QCD sector), reported as combination QN·d = 0.999 dgs + 0.092 d_mhat + ... (Fig. 3), plus couplings to alpha (ScalarPhoton) and m_e (ScalarElectron) in Figs. 4-5. The main 'nuclear' result maps onto a scalar-nucleon-type coupling (dimensionless d_g), so ScalarNucleon is the best match among enum options, though it is really a quark/gluon coupling combination. Frequency range 10 Hz to 10^8 Hz corresponds to masses ~4e-14 to ~4e-7 eV. No numerical data table or extractable point values are provided in the text; exclusion limits are only shown graphically (Figs. 3-5) without tabulated coordinates. Galactic halo density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed (also solar halo 1e5x and Earth halo scenarios). 95% CL stated. | Vision: This plot constrains d_me (ScalarElectron), NOT ScalarNucleon as hinted. The lower boundary envelope is formed at low mass by the 'Microscope, only d_me' cyan line and at higher mass by the Be-Al/Cu-Pb solid lines. The Microscope line rises steeply around 3-5e-12 eV. Beyond that the lowest constraint is the Be-Al/Cu-Pb green-brown lines near d_me ~ 0.06-50 rising with mass. Note paper abstract mentions quark/gluon couplings, but THIS figure (Fig 5) is for d_me electron mass coupling. | Calibration: No calibration needed
